Brandon, saw Celigo launch Ora with Agent Builder and the Enterprise MCP Server.

Shipping a major AI release usually means more in-market accounts in play than the GTM team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
